methods.what: Sum of three consecutive integer-part quotients n/s, n/(s+1), n/(s+2), each split into integer part plus fractional part
Second difference of integer parts plus second difference of fractional parts equals a small quantity epsilon
Second difference of the fractional parts takes only the values 0 or ±1
Vanishing of consecutive second differences of the fractional parts, combined into a third-order relation
Numerical division of 10000 by 80 through 86, giving quotients with remainders
